narr: A humid airmass remained in place beneath a west-northwesterly flow aloft. Weak boundaries triggered convection in WNW to ESE oriented bands, some which were anchored to higher terrain. The result was excessive rainfall with training cells.
ev: Photo posted on social media of water flowing over a road between Claxton and Powell.
Multiple roadways flooded, from back roads to main highways such as Clinton Hwy and Oak Ridge Hwy near Clinton.
Roads near the intersection of I-275 and Heiskell Road were under water.
Car stranded in flood waters near the intersection of Blackstock Ave and Oak Ave.
Roads inundated near the intersection of Central Ave and Irwin Dr.
Streets flooded near the intersection of West Emory Rd and Collier Rd.
Some homes on Pop Hollow Rd being evacuated.
